column8: ["The broad ivory field reads as a backing plate beneath seven sockets, dominating the machine instead of reading as a crafted housing.","Material richness is thin: the terracotta rims and brown edging do not convincingly distinguish rubbed brass, worn rubber and glazed ceramic.","The repeated plain rings and largely blank ceramic surface feel diagrammatic; the painting needs more character through material finish and purposeful contact wear.","Upper-left brightness and lower-right dark edging imply directional lighting, especially around the socket rims and outer perimeter."]

["The broad ivory field reads as a backing plate with seven matching rims, rather than a characterful machine housing; give the ceramic body more purposeful sculpting and worked character.","Material separation is weak: the orange rims read as terracotta rather than darkened brass, and the dark lining lacks a distinct matte-rubber character.","The ceramic is uniformly pale and softly mottled; richer glaze variation and contact-edge wear would reward closer inspection.","Bright upper-left bevels and dark lower-right edging imply directional light that will rotate with the sprite."]

["The broad ivory surface reads as a flat backing plate; it needs the substance and character of a built ceramic housing.","The seven rust-orange rims read as painted outlines rather than darkened brass and worn rubber. Give their contact edges distinct material texture and richer tonal structure.","The pale upper-left edging and dark lower-right edging imply directional illumination; use balanced shading around the contours so the housing can rotate without carrying a fixed light direction."]

["The broad ivory housing feels bland and underworked; its nearly uniform surface lacks convincing glaze and the character of a crafted kiln machine.","All seven seat rims read as soft rust-colored bands, with little distinction between rubbed brass and worn rubber. Sharpen material differences and concentrate wear along contact edges.","Bright upper edges and dark lower edges give the housing directional bevel lighting that would visibly rotate with the sprite. Use symmetric tonal shaping instead."]
